mint_rule: gold_seed minted once from crypto random bytes before any unit build, session or label call of this rerun. Never re-minted. Every other seed is the parent's.

new.first_turn: "/cso " followed by the parent's task text
"/cso " followed by the parent's task text

not_run.untold: descriptive in the parent's stage 0 and 1 only
not_run.sol: a separate call after this result

limits.doubling: none: the reused arms ran at these limits, so they stay fixed

units.counted: the parent's 52 stage 2 units (results post stage2-draw.json, role stage2), in its frozen session order (stage2-draw.json order) restricted to cso cells

pilot.rule: the parent's 2 stage 0 units, then its stage 1 units in position order until there are 5; if none of the 5 holds a tracked symlink in its session tree, the last stage 1 pick is replaced by the first stage 1 unit in position order that does

units.rebuild: every unit's session tree is rebuilt from its public parent commit before its session; a counted unit's tree_sha256 must match the first 16 hex digits in the image tag of each of its four stage 2 session records in the GEVA-561 export (sessions/stage2/<unit>/*/run.json, MANIFEST.sha256 e79fbea9582c8749b11199b83870aa317e242090facb346d83494a735f93b458), all four agreeing; its judge inputs come from the same unit build at the parent's pin, with the rebuilt advisory's GHSA id matching the one in the unit's name in stage2-draw.json; a pilot unit's digest is recorded at the preflight and checked again before its session
units.containment: the parent's gates (a) and (c) run again against the arm's install at a3ecfd53; a unit they hit leaves every contrast of this rerun, and is reported by name

exposure.rule: the parent's section 8, as written: a helper start call through gstack-cso-launcher returned a run id, at least one inspect or read call used that run, and a finish call ran
detector_fixes: start: a run id is that start's when the start printed it; or when the helper's run record saved from the session holds it, matched by order (the session's k-th unrefused start takes the record's k-th run, ordered by the creation time in its id), only when the unrefused starts and the record's runs are equal in number, else the record is not used for matching; or, when the helper didn't refuse that start, the first run id a later call prints or passes (its own output included) before any other start call. The detector reads sdk-messages.jsonl, whose events carry only seconds since session start, so matching is by order

used: an inspect or read call names the run by its id; or by a shell variable or command substitution while the session holds exactly one accepted start, when that call's output names the run id or it exited 0 with no helper refusal

finish: a finish call on the run counts when its own output holds the helper's finish object or it exited 0 with no helper refusal, even when a later command in the same Bash call failed; or the saved run record shows the run finished
exposure.regression: replayed over the parent's 104 stage 2 cso transcripts, the fixed detector gives 40/52 on Opus and 52/52 on particle-1, the counts the correction post (#444) published, and finds every run the frozen detector found
also_printed: the parent's frozen detector as run
a reading that also counts search and history as using the run

yield.primary: findings per cso session: every finding pass A extracts from the scored text, not only the first 10
also: share of cso sessions with no finding
findings per session where the procedure ran
findings the helper recorded per run, from the saved run record

contrasts: new cso minus old cso, Opus
new cso minus old cso, particle-1
second_family.decides: what we tell gstack's maintainer about the fix; not the verdict

analysis.test: McNemar with Obuchowski's clustered variance, two-sided; exact McNemar beside
analysis.verdicts: the parent's section 10, steps 1 to 5, in order, on the new cso arm against the reused none arm
analysis.headroom: admitted by the parent (plain Opus named 12/51 in stage 2)
analysis.mdd_note: [alpha 0.025, alpha 0.05]; null means no difference up to the discordant share reaches 80% power; from lanes/outcome-skills/h2h/analysis/power.ts mdd()

judge.route: fallback-opus-particle: openai/gpt-6.2-astra judges; gold by anthropic:claude-opus-5-5 and google/gemini-4-argon
judge.settings: the parent's deviation (d): medium effort, 65,536 output cap; gold at high effort and 32,000
judge.prompts: unchanged from the parent's harness at the results merge
judge.counted_sample_rule: sort the counted units by sha256 of '<gold_seed>:<unit id>' ascending (hex string order); walk the list taking each unit's Opus new-cso report, then its particle-1 report, skipping gap sessions, until 24 are taken; drawn before any judged number of the counted run is read
gates: kappa on named at least 0.6 on all gold reports (at least 100) and on non-anchor gold reports alone, with at least 10 in each class
on gold reports, the judge's disagreement rate on named in new cso reports and in none reports differs by at most 10 points
validity kappa at least 0.6 on pooled gold findings
refusals and over-cap gold drops at most 5% of gold reports
the parent's format-variant gates stand as passed on this route
judge.pilot_gate: on the 10 pilot cso reports: no refusal, no judge gap, and gold disagrees with the judge on named in at most 2
judge.on_failure: no counted number counts; the rows read judge not validated (FIX-METHOD) and the Captain decides
judge.gold_floor: at least 100 gold reports (both labellers agree); if fewer, the draw continues down the same list in the same way, up to 20 more reports (about $12 inside cso2-judge's cap); if 100 still aren't gold, the check fails on its floor

check_rules.anchor_fill: none: no oracle or stock anchor is added; a shortfall draws only the counted extension
check_rules.parent_gold: the parent's 85 gold reports enter as sealed, anchors included
check_rules.unchanged: every other parent judge setting (class_min 10, anchor_share_max 0.3, kappa minimums, validity finding minimum and its finding fill, format variants)

cso2-pilot.admission: a lease admits a session only while the cap holds its full allowance; each pilot cap leaves room for the fifth session at the planned price (particle-1 $3.60 after four at $0.80, allowance $3; Opus $17.20 after four at $4.00, allowance $16)

cso2-main.rule: 1.35 times central plus 4 parallel sessions at Opus's $16 allowance

cso2-judge.extension: up to 20 more gold reports, about $12, inside the cap
cso2-judge.rule: 1.35 times central plus 4 calls at Astra's largest, about $1.60

cso2-reserve.rule: moves only on the Captain's word for a named repair

interim_look.look: none at this size; if the pilot's re-pricing plans the counted run above $500 paid, one look at 26 of 52 units in the frozen order, with the parent's CV5 bounds
interim_look.schedule: if a look applies: pause after the first 26 units in the frozen order (52 sessions), judge them, test the primary family (new cso minus none, Holm over two models) at the first bounds; a contrast crossing its bound is decided; if both are decided the second half doesn't run; else run the second half and test at the second bounds; the second family is tested only at the end

planning_prices.basis: parent stage 2 measured: Opus cso $0.58, particle-1 cso $0.18, Opus none $4.11, particle-1 none $1.51, Astra judging $0.17 a session, Opus and Argon gold about $0.40 a report; the fixed /cso reads more code, so its sessions are priced near the plain arm's

secondaries_old_arm_exposure: the old cso arm's per-session exposure is the fixed detector replayed over its export transcript, keyed by unit and model, never stage2-sessions.tsv's procedure flags
pilot_print_check: every frozen secondary prints a value on the new pilot sessions, and a paired value where the parent's records in hand hold the same unit, model and measure; else it prints 'no pair in the pilot', which passes
